source: UK Government (DESNZ/DEFRA) GHG conversion factors 2025; Poore & Nemecek (2018); ICCT/Carbon Brief lifecycle estimates for embodied vehicle emissions; UK total from Global Carbon Budget consumption basis (part one)
note: All values kg CO2e per year unless stated. Flight factors include the radiative-forcing multiplier. The fixed baseline (public services, construction, goods) is computed at runtime as uk_total_kg minus the levers at average_settings, so an exactly-average reader reproduces part one's 7.1 t. average_settings is a modelling fiction (it includes fractional flights and averages over non-drivers) documented in the methodology.
